Copy of a marriage certificate

A certified copy of a marriage registered in Tarnmose can be requested from the Tarnmose Marriage Registry.

Fee
€21.40 per certified copy
Processing time
12 working days
Issuing office
Tarnmose Marriage Registry

Requests are made at the registry counter. This service has no online application.
